== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns William Macaw. A fresh audit of the surviving Rasharkin Presbyterian baptism transcription located a second parent-bearing McCaughern/Macaw household at the target townland. Hugh Macaw was born 3 February 1839 and baptised 3 March 1839 as the son of William and Mary Kilpatrick, resident at Lisnagaver (entry 125).<ref>Rasharkin Presbyterian baptisms, entries 125 and 204; [https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/RasharkinP/Baptisms_1834.html record].</ref> The same register records Jane Matilda Macaw, born 26 July 1843 and baptised 14 January 1844, as the daughter of William and Mary Kilpatrick at Granagh (entry 204). Named transcription reread 30 September 2026; originalmanuscriptuninspected. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns William Macaw. Rasharkin baptism transcription entry 125 gives Hugh Macaw’s birth as 3 February 1839 and his baptism as 3 March 1839. Another transcription gave 5 February for the birth; the original manuscript is required to settle the difference.<ref>Rasharkin Presbyterian baptism transcription; [https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/RasharkinP/Baptisms_1834.html record].</ref> Named transcription reread; original manuscript uninspected. The identification remains uncertain.
